'''Rothwell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] chief engineer of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was stationed aboard the ''[[Justice (Harrower-class)|Justice]]'' when it was boarded by the elite [[Republic Special Forces Division]] unit [[Havoc Squad]].<ref>{{TORcite|Inconspicuous Valor}}</ref>
